title: DOT DAO and the need for $JAMKB
quote: $JAMKB would be a token which maps at a fixed rate to the state footprint usage on Polkadot JAM. All $JAMKB would be initially owned by the DOT DAO (and therefore commanded by the aggregated instructions of DOT holders). Every one $JAMKB which a service holds would be enough to keep 1KB in Polkadot JAM's state footprint for as long as it is held. Moving the token out of the service would require the 1KB of state to first be cleared.
